text:
maria_ae: Heads up - Polestar (enterprise) asked for a committed capacity proposal. They sent traffic profile + security questionnaire. Need a presales plan: reserved GPU quota, autoscale fallback, spot eviction hedge, and rough cost delta vs hosted usage. Can someone assemble numbers and an ops runbook?

raj_se: I can draft. Quick ask: target p50 latency < 300ms, mixed chat + embeddings. Their perf test shows 120 qps peak (short bursts to 300 qps), avg request 80 tokens.

olivia_sre: 300 qps bursts are the risky bit. If they want p50 < 300ms on dedicated, we should provision for sustained 120 qps and a burst headroom policy.

jin_infra: For reserved capacity I'd recommend reserving 8x A10s (or equivalent) for baseline; use 2x extra on burst-credit pool. That maps to ~160 concurrent generation slots for our gen model. Spot can cover additional 140 qps but with eviction mitigation.

maria_ae: Can you translate that into a cost delta (monthly) vs pure hosted? Also need a short description to add to the quote doc for the sales team.

raj_se: Rough calc: baseline (8 A10 equiv) + 2 burst = baseline monthly $XXk (estimate). Hosted at observed profile ~2.2x cost due to on-demand elastic pricing on bursts. I'll attach numbers but here is the autoscale policy we should propose:

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  baseline_slots: 160
  burst_pool: 2_gpus
  scale_up_threshold: 75_percent_util
  scale_down_threshold: 35_percent_util
  max_burst_duration: 15m
  spot_fallback: true
  spot_fallback_policy:
    eviction_action: "failover-to-smaller-model-or-queue"
```

olivia_sre: Add KV-cache warming window for canary rollouts. Important: warm caches per deployment per AZ to avoid cold tails. Suggest a staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 20 minutes.

jin_infra: On the quota side customer asked about AZ affinity and minimum pool per AZ. Recommend 2 GPUs reserved per AZ across 3 AZs so we maintain regional availability and reduce single-AZ failure risk.

maria_ae: Security folks want to confirm the questionnaire answers around key management and audit logs. @sec_bot can you attach the completed questionnaire snippet?

sec_bot: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/teams/security/polestar_q1_response_v1 (answers: KMS: AWS-KMS, logs: syslog+S3 retention 90d, SOC2 controls referenced). :white_check_mark:

raj_se: Ops runbook (short):
1) If spot eviction -> immediately redirect new requests to reserved pool.
2) If reserved pool > 80% for >5m -> trigger burst GPUs from burst-pool.
3) If total capacity hit and latency > 500ms for 2m -> apply queued-backpressure and notify AE.
4) Automated fallback: degrade to quantized model variant (smaller) after 30s sustained pressure.

maria_ae: Nice. Can you add the exact slack ops-signal we should hit and the required CC list for alerts? Sales needs it in the SOW.

olivia_sre: Alerting: channel #prod-surge-alerts, pager to oncall + ops duty. CC list: olivia_sre, jin_infra, raj_se, maria_ae. Add a webhook to deploy-bot that posts runbook link.

deploy-bot: linked runbook: https://internal.runbooks/polestar-capacity-hedge-v1 (autodoc created).

maria_ae: I'll pull these into the quote doc and add the pricing delta. Raj, can you finalize the numbers and the YAML example into a short PRD by EOD?

raj_se: On it. Will post PRD link here when ready. :thumbsup:

maria_ae: Thanks everyone - feel free to DM if you need more from the customer (they provided sample logs + traffic CSV).
